name: Posten Bring Checkout
author: Posten Bring AS

sections.description:
Official Posten Bring checkout plugin for WooCommerce

Posten Bring AS offers comprehensive logistics solutions. The app showcases B2C shipping methods, streamlines customer choices with lead time, environmental data, and parcel locker options.
The app ensures effortless shipping by offering easy installation, updates, rate adjustments, and direct label printing from the administration pages. Available for shipments in Norway, Sweden & Denmark.

  • Easy to install; we also have a team that can guide you if you have questions.
  • Configure shipping prices & lead time for your web shop in real-time.
  • Support for multiple B2C services: mailbox, pickup point and home delivery.

External services

This plugin communicates with official Bring APIs api.bring.com to be able to present available shipping options, pickup points,
prices and lead time during checkout, as well as booking shipments and generating labels. A Mybring account is required to
communicate with the APIs. The general Mybring terms and conditions apply.

The following data will be used when communicating with the APIs:

  • Recipient address and contact information
  • Sender address and contact information
  • Basic shipment details (weight, number of items/packages)
  • For single parcel shipments of 0340 (PICKUP_PARCEL) from NO to SE/DK, customs requires information about parcel contents as described here.
sections.installation:
This plugin requires a Mybring account.

  1. Install the plugin via WordPress, or upload posten-bring-checkout to the `/wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress “Plugins” page
  3. Go to Mybring webshop configuration and log in as an administrator
  4. Configure your webshop, available shipping options, prices, discounts and packaging time
  5. Copy the API key
  6. Go back to the Posten Bring settings page (Posten Bring -> Settings)
  7. Press Use key to activate
sections.faq: There is a FAQ page in the extension itself. Go to Posten Bring -> FAQ.
